# AVRAI

AVRAI is building a more thoughtful way to discover places and make plans that
fit real-world context. Its proposed approach considers details such as timing,
company, and what someone needs in the moment, while leaving the next choice
with the person.

## Public pages

- https://www.avrai.org/ — overview and product direction.
- https://www.avrai.org/access — early access request form.
- https://business.avrai.org/signup — separate business account creation.

The former `/about` page redirects to the overview's `#how-it-works` section.
The former `/contact` page redirects to the footer's `#contact` section. The
former `/business` page redirects to the business signup URL.

## Access and contact

Submitting the `/access` form requests follow-up about possible access. It does
not create an account, guarantee a place, or provide immediate access. General
questions can go to info@avrai.org; privacy questions to privacy@avrai.org.

## Evidence boundary

The public site describes a product direction and early access. It does not
claim empirically validated outcomes, automatic external actions, or access to
raw personal data. A form success message is not independent proof of storage
or access approval.
